nodes.label: Statement 4: Antipsychotic Medication Treatment and Monitoring
nodes.rationale: Antipsychotic medication is a core component of schizophrenia care; benefits viewed as far outweighing harms when effectiveness and side effects are monitored.

nodes.label: Antipsychotic Selection by Preferences, Response, Side Effects, and Pharmacology
nodes.rationale: No evidence-based FGA versus SGA ranking exists, so choice weighs prior response, side-effect profile, formulations, interactions, receptor binding, and pharmacokinetics.
